embedded.credit: Cordoni, Hecker, Crippa, Gallego Aldama, Borragán Santos and Norscia
embedded.license: Article CC BY 4.0; no separate movie license stated on the article player
embedded.modifications: None. Original publisher-hosted MP4. Poster is an unedited frame at 2 seconds.
embedded.teaching_note: The recording shows elephant partners exchanging playful trunk and head movements. Track the actor’s movement and the partner’s rapidly repeated action; movement timing is the behavioral basis for the study’s comparison with matched control periods. The clip illustrates a measured motor sequence rather than direct tickling.
